body:
Implements the remaining piece of #454 Task 3, motivated by measured production data from a consumer repo (lolipopshock/rl-lit issue 12, run 29309332883, `ubuntu-latest`): with warm runtime caches, portal setup spent **2.6s restoring the runtime and 13.1s downloading the Claude CLI** — on the answer-first default path, where the portal never invokes a model. The 👀 landed at T+32s; ~13s of that was a download the job never used (and the answer job re-downloads it on its own VM regardless).

## The ordering invariant

Nothing heavier than the restored runtime may precede the first user-visible reaction:

- New `install-agent-cli` composite: the two CLI install steps extracted verbatim; `setup-agent-runtime` delegates to it, so every route job stays byte-identical.
- The portal's setup call passes `install_codex`/`install_claude` as hard `"false"`.
- Dedicated, gated install steps sit immediately before the only three portal steps that can run a model — opt-in dispatch triage, the follow-up intent gate, and implement metadata — sharing each step's exact condition, so the download happens only when needed and always after the reaction.
- The portal's early answer-provider resolution is removed: its only consumer was the setup install flags (the follow-up gate uses its own provider step; the answer job keeps its own resolution).

Envelope tests pin all of it: literal-false setup flags, no CLI-installing step (composite or inline) before the reaction, per-model-step gated installs sharing conditions, and setup-agent-runtime containing no inline installer.

## Expected effect (hosted runners)

Portal setup ~17s → ~4s; 👀 ~T+32s → ~T+19s on current main, and ~T+7s once #474's pre-checkout fast-ack lands. Default-path portals stop consuming CLI download bandwidth entirely. Self-hosted runners with preinstalled CLIs were already short-circuiting and are unaffected.

Notes: no CHANGELOG edit per the release-time convention (#477). Expected textual conflict with #474 in the portal steps region — whichever merges second rebases trivially.

comments.body: Superseded by the simpler approach: cache the CLI binaries inside the existing install steps (same restore/save discipline as the runtime cache) instead of deferring installation with a companion action. Caching helps every CLI-installing job, not just the portal, and adds no new actions or flag plumbing.

title: Defer portal CLI installation until a model step needs it
